title: ChronoLink: Anchor & Echo
tagline: One of you is in 1924, the other in the same facility's 2026 ruins. Plant a seed in the past to bridge a chasm in the future; piece together a burnt black box and a 1924 ledger to crack the boiler safe. 40 chambers of split-era logic puzzles.

roles.name: The Anchor (1924)
roles.description: WASD and E. Plants, turns valves, pulls levers and uses the Chronal Stash Box.

roles.name: The Echo (2026)
roles.description: Arrows, Enter/E and F. Kicks rusted bars, loots the stash box and scans black boxes with LIDAR.

multiplayer.style: asymmetric co-op, split screen or two tabs
multiplayer.notes: Split screen on one keyboard by default. A second tab links automatically over BroadcastChannel('chronolink-sync'); the Online button links two devices through the hub relay with a 4-letter code.
